data.scan_interval: Update interval (seconds, between 3600 = 1 hour and 86400 = 24 hours)

reauth_confirm.title: Pago Plătește — re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Pago rejected the saved password for {email}. Enter the current password.

error.auth_failed: Authentication failed. Check your email and password.
error.connection_failed: Could not connect to the Pago server.

licenta.title: Pago Plătește license
licenta.description:
{license_status}

Enter the license key you received by email.

data_description.license_key: The key from your license email, in the form PAGO-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.

error.license_key_invalid: This key is not valid for Pago Plătește. Copy the whole key from the email: keys for this integration start with PAGO-.
error.license_already_used: This key is active on another Home Assistant instance. The license email address receives a link to move it; after you confirm, enter the key here again.
error.license_fingerprint_mismatch: Activation could not be confirmed for this instance. Try again; if the message repeats, use the “License problem” form.
error.license_network_error: The license server cannot be reached. Check that Home Assistant has internet access and try again.
error.license_server_error: The license server could not check the key right now. Try again in a few minutes.
error.already_configured: This Pago account is already configured.

trial_expired.title: The Pago Plătește free trial has ended
trial_expired.description:
Sensors stop updating until a license is activated.

[Get a license]({learn_more_url})

license_expired.title: The Pago Plătește license has expired
license_expired.description:
Sensors stop updating until the license is renewed.

[Get a new license]({learn_more_url})
